newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SOYMEAL WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SOYMEAL WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 34,400 MT were primarily the result of major increases for Japan (17,300 MT) and Ecuador (8,100 MT, including 8,000 MT switched from unknown destinations).
Sales of 61,200 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for unknown destinations (20,000 MT), Ireland (20,000 MT), and New Zealand (18,000 MT).

Exports of 50,400 MT were three-quarters above the previous week, but 19 percent less than the 4-week average. Japan (13,200 MT), Ecuador (10,100 MT), and Canada (9,000 MT) were the principal recipients.
